business_problem: Citi Wealth wanted to reduce the friction of clients navigating apps, calls, and meetings by giving U.S. wealth clients real-time, personalized access to market insights, opportunity prompts, and advisor-supported financial guidance.
solution_summary: Citi Wealth built Citi Sky as an always-on advisor-assisting wealth agent on Google Cloud's AI stack. The implementation uses Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform as the environment for building, scaling, governing, and optimizing the agent, with Gemini models supplying the reasoning and financial guidance layer. To create a multimodal virtual persona, Citi combined Google DeepMind's real-time avatar technology with Gemini's Live API so clients can interact through low-latency voice, audio, and video conversations in English and Spanish. The agent is being integrated into Citi Wealth platforms in the U.S. to work alongside financial advisors, drawing on grounded internal wealth data such as Chief Investment Office market insights and CD maturity prompts. The release does not name storage products, but it says interactions are built on a secure, grounded data foundation designed for regulatory compliance.

data_flow: Citi Wealth client interactions in English or Spanish enter Citi Sky through voice, avatar, audio, and video interfaces powered by Gemini's Live API and Google DeepMind's real-time avatar technology. Gemini models running on Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform combine market insights from Citi Wealth's Chief Investment Office and event triggers such as CD maturity prompts on a secure, grounded data foundation, then return personalized guidance into Citi Wealth platforms for clients and financial advisors.
